messages:
Elena (Security): Thanks everyone — quick follow-up from today's all-hands about partner onboarding & evidence for SOC2/ISO. We said we'd produce a playbook. I have a few clarifying Qs

Marcus (CTO): Good call. We should make this partner-specific. Key areas: BYOK/KMS, VPC/network setup, audit log exports, and a minimal artifacts checklist.

Elena (Security): Right — need to be explicit about what we provide vs what partners must attest to.

Priya (Compliance): From a SOC2 perspective we need: architecture diagrams, control owners, sample evidence for key controls (access reviews, key rotation), and an attestation from the partner for any shared controls. For ISO add encryption and key lifecycle docs.

Jules (Infra Eng): For VPC we can snapshot the peering config, route tables, and SGs. For logs we can export to partner buckets or provide an S3/GCS export. Proposed export path convention: `/audit-exports/partners/<partner-id>/YYYYMMDD.log`.

Elena (Security): Do we have a template for the export format / retention metadata?

Jules (Infra Eng): Not yet. I'll draft a JSONL schema: each record will have timestamp, request_id, principal, action, resource, success, region. Example: ```{"ts":"2024-10-01T12:00:00Z","principal":"svc-redwood","action":"GenerateTokens","resource":"model-a","success":true}```

Noah (DevRel): I'll own the partner-facing README + onboarding checklist (what to ask partners for, how to request BYOK). ETA: 2 weeks. Will include sample commands & troubleshooting. :+1:

Sam (Product): On BYOK/KMS — we support customer-managed keys. Need a clear acceptance criteria list: key policy bindings, key access logs enabled, rotation schedule documented, and proof of HSM vs software key if requested. Decide whether HSM-backed BYOK is an opt-in premium.

Priya (Compliance): For ISO controls, add traffic diagrams, TLS termination point, and key generation / destruction evidence. Also require periodic uploads into the evidence portal for ongoing compliance testing.

Elena (Security): Action items (owners + ETA):
- Noah: partner README + checklist — due 2024-11-08
- Jules: log-export spec + example JSONL + retention recommendations — due 2024-10-25
- Sam: BYOK/KMS acceptance criteria doc (including HSM decision) — due 2024-10-20
- Priya: partner artifact checklist for SOC2/ISO — due 2024-10-28
Please confirm owners and dates. :thumbsup:

Marcus (CTO): Confirmed. Add a pilot with a real partner (recommend PartnerX) to validate the flow and surface edge cases. @Elena to coordinate.

Elena (Security): I'll set up weekly 30m office hours starting next Wednesday for partner onboarding questions — invites to Partner Ops, Solutions Eng, Security, Compliance.

ops-bot: Meeting scheduled: "Partner Evidence Office Hours" — Wednesdays 11:00–11:30 PT, starting 2024-10-09. Calendar invites sent.

Noah (DevRel): I'll prep a 10-min walkthrough of the README + a short checklist demo for the first office hours.

Priya (Compliance): Also flag: for SOC2 testing we may need sample support transcripts and sample incident tickets where applicable. Add that to the artifacts list.

Elena (Security): Noted. I'll create the shared doc at go/internal/soc2-partner-playbook and post the link here once it's live.

Marcus (CTO): Nice progress — capture owners and acceptance criteria in the doc and we'll review at the next leadership sync.

Elena (Security): Thanks all — I'll post the initial draft by EOD Monday and tag owners for review.
